**Fix the hygiene-gate failure before reporting a pass.** `scripts/check_hygiene.sh` scans all tracked `hafapass_frontend` files and exits with status 1 when it finds `console.log`. The three QA-script calls are therefore not permitted by this check. Replace them with equivalent non-`console.log` output, rerun the hygiene and freeze checks, and update the report only if both pass.
Suggested fix
```diff - page.on('pageerror', error=>console.log('pageerror',error.message)) + page.on('pageerror', error=>process.stdout.write(`pageerror ${error.message}\n`)) ... - console.log(engine,width,scene,'passed') + process.stdout.write(`${engine} ${width} ${scene} passed\n`) ``` ```diff - console.log('Both Netlify passes: matching headers; preview-specific no-referrer retained; favicon redirects resolved.') + process.stdout.write('Both Netlify passes: matching headers; preview-specific no-referrer retained; favicon redirects resolved.\n') ```

After applying the fix, consider running `coderabbit review --agent` for local review. Visit https://docs.coderabbit.ai/cli?utm_source=ghpr ```

The PWA test checks served favicon responses, not each Netlify redirect's `from`, `to`, and status. Add assertions for all three mappings in both resolved configurations before logging success.

** Minor** · **Functional Correctness** · **Quick win** **Handle all terminal punctuation in the schedule formatter.** `payout_schedule_text` is free-form. This expression removes only periods and whitespace, then always appends a period. For example, `within 7 days?` renders as `Payouts by check within 7 days?.`, and `...` renders as `Payouts by check .`. Use one shared formatter that trims the text and appends a period only when the text has no terminal punctuation. Apply it in `FeeTermsNote.jsx`, `FinancesPage.jsx`, and `PayoutMethodSection.jsx`. Add tests for these inputs. The supplied fee-terms contract permits any non-empty string after trimming. As per path instructions, add tests for this changed user-visible behavior.

Use it for payout schedule rendering in FeeTermsNote, FinancesPage, and PayoutMethodSection, and add tests covering text ending in a question mark and an ellipsis, as well as text needing a period. After applying the fix, consider running `coderabbit review --agent` for local review. Visit https://docs.coderabbit.ai/cli?utm_source=ghpr ```
